cases.title: UNIPARK smishing infrastructure
cases.summary: From one SMS and a newly registered domain to exact-hash kit reuse, 126 related hostnames and a carefully bounded infrastructure assessment.

reproducibility.preserved_inputs: Published static graph and linked versioned evidence bundle; original SMS and provider observations only to the extent preserved in that release.
reproducibility.transformations: Follow the article's exact-hash and hostname joins against released records; verify supplied hashes before using a downloaded bundle.
reproducibility.source_attributed_conclusions: The 126-host relationship and infrastructure assessment are source-attributed to the time-bounded investigation, not independently recollected by this UI.
reproducibility.unavailable: No replay of live phishing pages, hidden provider retention or unpreserved requests. Bundle byte completeness has not been re-audited by this metadata release.
reproducibility.analytical_cutoff: 2026-08-14 publication state; individual observations retain their recorded times.

cases.title: Adform supply-chain crypto clipper
cases.summary: Captured JavaScript, exact response hashes and reproduced public-chain paths kept separate from shared-episode, victim, loss and operator claims.

reproducibility.preserved_inputs: Published graph, investigation excerpts and linked evidence index; preserve each captured response hash and stated chain snapshot.
reproducibility.transformations: Repeat only the documented static decoding, exact-response comparisons and archived chain arithmetic for inputs actually supplied by the evidence index.
reproducibility.source_attributed_conclusions: Published JavaScript and public-chain path interpretations remain separate from operator identity, victims and loss claims.
reproducibility.unavailable: No execution of captured JavaScript, live endpoint requests or reconstruction of missing TRON evidence. Explorer results may change outside the stated snapshot.
reproducibility.analytical_cutoff: 2026-08-23 analytical update; see the investigation for per-chain snapshot cutoffs.

cases.title: Hostinger-themed Pages phishing infrastructure
cases.summary: From 298 fixed-pattern Pages task names to exact credential-core reuse, versioned tracker modules, separate Render functions and an explicitly bounded kit-family assessment.
cases.package_note: Packaging-integrity correction only. Investigation observations and analytical claims remain dated 27 August 2026. Earlier packages are retained with errata.

reproducibility.preserved_inputs: Published graph and immutable v1.1.1 research-artifacts package identified by the catalogue link.
reproducibility.transformations: Use the released static comparison instructions and manifests for exact credential-core/tracker hashes and the named domain-set counts.
reproducibility.source_attributed_conclusions: The 298 task-name and kit-family statements belong to the 27 August investigation; common code does not identify a shared operator or provider compromise.
reproducibility.unavailable: No contact with Pages or Render endpoints, no credential submission and no recovery of unavailable original collection records. Packaging integrity does not validate attribution.
reproducibility.analytical_cutoff: 2026-08-27; the 2026-09-07 package correction is not new analytical evidence.

cases.title: Malicious Python loader on GitHub
cases.summary: Static reconstruction of a deceptive repository, embedded-key decryption, encoded retrieval infrastructure and a missing final stage.

reproducibility.preserved_inputs: Published article excerpts and graph JSON. This case has no separately linked complete original-sample evidence bundle.
reproducibility.transformations: Trace the published static layers and decoded retrieval strings in the excerpts; inspect as text only.
reproducibility.source_attributed_conclusions: The loader assessment follows the published static analysis. The graph re-expresses that source account rather than a new byte-for-byte sample replication.
reproducibility.unavailable: The final stage is unavailable. Complete original bytes, dependency state and runtime behavior are not supplied for independent end-to-end replay; no family or exfiltration verdict is justified.
reproducibility.analytical_cutoff: 2024-11-10 original analysis; 2026-08-14 graph/publication update is not a new malware observation.
